theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gv_vertical_variation_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid m)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid m → Euclid m) (κ : ℝ) (ξ : Euclid m) (r : ℝ) (P : Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (ζ : Euclid n → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (e : Euclid m), W ⊆ U → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid m → Euclid m, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → (∀ y, ‖P y‖ ≤ ‖y‖) → (∀ x ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall ξ r, ‖x - ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖P (x - ξ)‖ ^ 2 + r ^ 2 / 16) → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2) → (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → ‖e‖ ≤ 1 → IntegrableOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ ζ (P (x - ξ)) (P ((approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection e))) (closedBall ξ r) R.measure ∧ ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in closedBall ξ r, fderiv ℝ ζ (P (x - ξ)) (P ((approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection e)) ∂R.measure| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal G * (ENNReal.ofReal (κ * r / 2) * R.measure (closedBall ξ r))
